name: STIHL MS 201 T C-M
blurb: 12″, 14″ and 16″ bars on 3/8″ low-profile “Picco” chain, .050″ gauge, 44, 50 and 55 drive links, per STIHL’s chain-selection chart.
intro: The MS 201 T C-M is STIHL's top-handle arborist saw, and its chain is STIHL's 3/8″ PICCO (63 PM3) loop — the low-profile family, not the standard 3/8″ chain used on the larger MS 311 or MS 362. STIHL's selection chart lists 12″, 14″ and 16″ lightweight bars for it, in a block shared with the MS 192 and MS 193 saws. Each row below restates the chart's drive-link count and chain marketing number. The STIHL chart we could read is dated 1 October 2017, so for any saw made after that, confirm against the bar stamp or STIHL's current chart before ordering.

bars.note: STIHL's chart lists chain 63 PM3 44 (3/8″ PICCO) with lightweight bar 3005 000 7405 for this group of saws. The STIHL chart we could read is dated 1 October 2017, so for any saw made after that, confirm against the bar stamp or STIHL's current chart before ordering.
